sql.if: AND (COALESCE(loc.location_total, 0) <> b.qty_total OR COALESCE(loc.location_frozen, 0) <> b.qty_frozen OR COALESCE(loc.invalid_location_rows, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(fl.flow_net, 0) <> b.qty_total OR COALESCE(lk.active_lock_qty, 0) <> b.qty_frozen OR COALESCE(fl.opening_flow_count, 0) = 0)

mapper.sql: FROM ph_inv_batch b JOIN ph_warehouse w ON w.id = b.warehouse_id AND w.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND w.store_id = b.store_id AND w.deleted = b'0' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.tenant_id, s.batch_id, SUM(s.qty) AS location_total, SUM(s.qty_frozen) AS location_frozen, SUM(CASE WHEN l.id IS NULL OR l.warehouse_id <> b2.warehouse_id OR s.drug_id <> b2.drug_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_location_rows FROM ph_inv_location_stock s JOIN ph_inv_batch b2 ON b2.id = s.batch_id AND b2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id LEFT JOIN ph_location l ON l.id = s.location_id AND l.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND l.deleted = b'0' WHERE s.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND s.deleted = b'0' GROUP BY s.tenant_id, s.batch_id ) loc ON loc.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND loc.batch_id = b.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT f.tenant_id, f.batch_id, SUM(f.in_qty - f.out_qty) AS flow_net, SUM(CASE WHEN f.flow_type = 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opening_flow_count, MAX(f.id) AS last_flow_id FROM ph_inv_flow f WHERE f.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND f.deleted = b'0' GROUP BY f.tenant_id, f.batch_id ) fl ON fl.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND fl.batch_id = b.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l.tenant_id, l.batch_id, SUM(l.qty) AS active_lock_qty FROM ph_inv_lock l WHERE l.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND l.status = 0 AND l.deleted = b'0' GROUP BY l.tenant_id, l.batch_id ) lk ON lk.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND lk.batch_id = b.id WHERE
mapper.select:
SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.warehouse_id, b.drug_id, b.batch_no, b.qty_total AS batch_total, b.qty_avail AS batch_avail, b.qty_frozen AS batch_frozen, COALESCE(loc.location_total, 0) AS location_total, COALESCE(loc.location_frozen, 0) AS location_frozen, COALESCE(loc.invalid_location_rows, 0) AS invalid_location_rows, COALESCE(fl.flow_net, 0) AS flow_net, COALESCE(fl.opening_flow_count, 0) AS opening_flow_count, COALESCE(lk.active_lock_qty, 0) AS active_lock_qty, fl.last_flow_id
ORDER BY b.id LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
